narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -4.85 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 17.198-17.291 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 17.375; the first objective pays 0.44R at 17.141.

plan.triggerRule: footprint exh fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 17.375 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 A/A+ demoted: no positive-delta absorption or CVD divergence at the pullback zone

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 34/100 — trend broken, liq magnets below

factors.name: Liquidation Gravity
factors.detail: long liq $19k -1.4% below · short liq $4k +3.4% above

fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
